text: Reverse Entropy is a Destruction warlock talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Internal Combustion.

The Return to Karazhan is a megadungeon located in southern Deadwind Pass in the Eastern Kingdoms, designed for level 110 characters. It prominently features the story of the Last Guardian, Medivh, as well as his apprentice, Khadgar. Return to Karazhan features many encounters found in its spiritual predecessor, such as Attumen the Huntsman, Moroes, Maiden of Virtue, and The Curator. It also features new encounters and original story elements, including the battle against the twisted shade of the Guardian Medivh and a new, fearsome Legion commander, known as Viz'aduum the Watcher, who intends to anchor the tower into the Twisting Nether and turn it into a second major gateway for the Burning

Reylar the Stormcaller is a ghostly vrykul mystic found near the entrance of the Tomb of the Old Kings in Stormheim during Legacy of the Icebreaker. He is maintaining the group of Swirling Storms found near the entrance and which become permanently dormant upon his death.
Return to Karazhan Guild Run is an achievement earned from defeating Viz'aduum the Watcher in the Return to Karazhan instance while in a guild group.
Revenants of the Depths are sea revenant creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Revitalized Ghouls are found at Kyranastrasz' Rest on the Lost Glacier. Killing them will grant stacks of Essence of the Red.
Revitalized Skeletons are found at Kyranastrasz' Rest on the Lost Glacier. Killing them will grant stacks of Essence of the Red.
Revitalized Monstrosities are found at Kyranastrasz' Rest on the Lost Glacier. Killing them will grant stacks of Essence of the Red.
Revantusk Hexxers are forest trolls located in the Hinterlands.
Revantusk Stalkers are forest trolls located in Shaol'watha in the Hinterlands.
Rez the Tombwatcher is a darkglare located in the Conclave of Torment in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Revantusk Drummers are forest trolls located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
Revantusk Watchers are forest trolls located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
Revantusk Speakers are forest troll emissaries of the Revantusk tribe located at the Terrace of the Speakers in Dazar'alor. One is present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.

The Return to Karazhan trailer is the official trailer for World of Warcraft Patch 7.1: Return to Karazhan. The trailer shows Moroes assassinating Mage Darius and inviting the Burning Legion into Karazhan.
Revenants of Neptulon are water revenants located in Abyssal Depths.
Revitalizing Voodoo Totem drops from Vol'kaal in Atal'Dazar. It summons Revitalized Voodoo Totem.
The Rezan Idol is a common Zandalari archaeology artifact that requires 50 Zandalari Archaeology Fragments to solve.
Reveler's Edge is a quest reward from No Party Like a Trogg Party.

Returned Predators are skeletal raptors located at the Burial Mound in Nazmir. __NOTOC__
Revantusk Mourners are forest trolls located in Dazar'alor during The King's Death.
Rewired Harvesters are harvest golems located in Stormsong Valley and Tiragarde Sound.
Revlis Ore drops from Awoken Guardians in Drustvar, and Dreadcoil Myrmidons and Dreadcoil Seekers in Zuldazar.
Revitalized Voodoo Totem is a totem summoned by Revitalizing Voodoo Totem.

Revelers of Time are bronze dragons located throughout the Caverns of Time. They can be seen cheering next to the Horde and Alliance banners or dancing in the Tavern of Time and playing volleyball. Others, upon entering the Timeless Tunnel, transform into their elven forms and run through the tunnel.

Revendreth, Court of the Venthyr, is one of the infinite realms of the Shadowlands founded by Sire Denathrius and inhabited by the Venthyr Covenant. It is a land of gothic spires and dark secrets, and no soul wishes to end up here. Souls sent here by the Arbiter tend to be prideful or have some other flaw preventing them from serving in or going to one of the other realms, and they come here to atone for their sins and hopefully be redeemed, as the alternative is being cast into the Maw. It is the duty of the vampiric venthyr to prepare the souls—through unimaginable torment. Although the realm is mostly shrouded in darkness, there are parts of Revendreth where the Light has broken through t

Returned Hatchlings are skeletal raptors found in western Nazmir, near the Terrace of Sorrows.
Revenge is Best Served Speedily is a quest achievement earned by riding the frog loa and completing the Nazmir world quest "Revenge of Krag'wa" in 45 seconds while not in a group.
Reverberating Silver Band is a quest reward from The Mnemonic Locus.

The Revendreth storyline is the final of the four level-up storylines in World of Warcraft: Shadowlands. The Winter Queen of Ardenweald realizes that she and the other leaders require significantly more anima to fend off The Jailer, so she sends the adventurer to Revendreth with a request. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement The Master of Revendreth.
Rezan's Fury is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can be found on Azerite Armor from Zuldazar, Atal'Dazar, and Kings' Rest.

.]] Revendreth jailers are floating humanoid creatures found in Revendreth. They look similar to jailer demons. Many venthyr consider the extraction of anima from souls to be their sacred duty, but as a result of Revendreth's fall to depravity under Sire Denathrius, creatures like Executor Tarvold were allowed to torture souls for their own pleasure.

Return to Oribos may refer to the following Shadowlands quests: *Return to Oribos (Ardenweald) (Ardenweald) *Return to Oribos (Bastion) (Bastion) *Return to Oribos (Maldraxxus) (Maldraxxus) *Return to Oribos (Revendreth) (Revendreth) *Return to Oribos (Torghast) (Torghast) *Return to Oribos (battlegrounds) (battlegrounds)
Rezan's Command is an Azerite trait for all classes. It doesn't appear to be available.
Revive Champion was one of the unimplemented priest's champion spells discovered during beta.
Revitalizing Jewel Doublet is created with Shadowlands Jewelcrafting (30); taught by Design: Revitalizing Jewel Doublet.
Revantusk War Drums are provided as an objective for Stomp To My Beat.
__NOTOC__ Revelation Key drops from the Protector of the First Ones in Zereth Mortis.
Rexxar's Refuge was a planned subzone in Gorgrond. The area is likely to have been a camp belonging to .
__NOTOC__ Returned Terrors are dire troll zombies located at the Necropolis in Nazmir during Dark Mojo for a Dark Loa.
Returned Ascended are Forsworn kyrian located in the Seat of the Archon during The New Path.
Returned Aspirants are Forsworn kyrian located in the Seat of the Archon during The New Path.
__NOTOC__ Return to Lordaeron is a quest achievement earned by completing the Return to Lordaeron post-Shadowlands questline.

Reversal of Fortune is a conduit for hunters. It drops from the Council of Blood in Castle Nathria, So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, and the Jailer in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It is also sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Reverence for the Flame is a buff available during the Midsummer Fire Festival. It is automatically given to the player when they honor one of the bonfires during the event.
Rex is a corgi located with Aurastil in Valdrakken. They can be found pacing back and forth between the Bronze Enclave and the Emerald Enclave.
Reviette is a nightborne located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken. She wears a Tabard of the Wyrmrest Accord.
Return to Roscha concludes the optional "Mudfin Village" storyline at Timberstep Outpost.
Revitalizing Red Carving is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (20); taught by Design: Revitalizing Red Carving.
Reveling Shimmerwings are butterflies located in the Waking Shores.
Revealing Dragon's Eye is a quest item provided for Nowhere to Hide (Thaldraszus) in Valdrakken.

Reviving the Machine breadcrumbs players to the Revival Catalyst Console at Tyrhold, which allows players to convert non-tier loot into tier loot for the set bonus using account-wide Catalyst Charges.

Revival Catalyst is an account-wide weekly quest, asking players to complete group content to gain Catalyst Charges for the Revival Catalyst. Said charges can be used to convert non-tier gear into the tier equivalent. Make sure to pick it up before doing any group activity else credit will not be retroactively granted... Antuka will appear by the Great Vault in Valdrakken or at the Revival Catalyst itself in Thaldraszus for ease-of-acquisition.
Review Collection Box is found in Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Return to Viridia concludes the primary Forbidden Reach storyline.
Reusable Oversized Bobber is an achievement reward from Discombobberlated.
Reverse Racer: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all reverse races in the Dragon Isles.
Reverse Racer: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining silver in all reverse races in the Dragon Isles.
Reverse Racer: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining gold in all reverse races in the Dragon Isles.

The Revealed Portal to Naxxramas is found at just west of the crossroads in eastern Plaguewood of the Eastern Plaguelands. Complete the Wards of the Dread Citadel achievement to reveal the portal. The portal leads to Naxxramas with additional secrets unlocked. Inside, a Portal to Eastern Plaguelands leads back out.
Rewind and Reconcile concludes the Dawn of the Infinite storyline. Check in with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza, and Chromie at the Temporal Conflux after leaving the instance.
Reverie is sold by Elianna in the Emerald Dream for 1 Dream Infusion.
Rickle Goldgrubber is a goblin banker that works at Stranglethorn Trust Bank located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

__NOTOC__ Rhahk'Zor was an ogre in the Deadmines. Rhahk'zor was the foreman in charge of Edwin VanCleef's construction projects. When Jerias Bloodvein invaded the Deadmines, his pirates killed Rhahk'Zor.
Ribbly Screwspigot is a goblin who hides from bounty hunters in the Grim Guzzler bar in Blackrock Depths.
Ribbly's Bandolier drops from Ribbly Screwspigot in Blackrock Depths.
Ribbly's Quiver drops from Ribbly Screwspigot in the Blackrock Depths dungeon.
Rhahk'Zor's Hammer drops from from Rhahk'Zor in the Deadmines.
Rhapsody Malt is a drink that was created by Rhapsody Shindigger. It can be purchased for from: * in Dun Morogh * in Loch Modan * in the Hinterlands
Rich Purple Silk Shirt is a type of shirt crafted by tailors.
The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet twitches in your hand, demanding to be recombined with its brothers.

Rezlak is a goblin quest giver located by the road just north of the canyons south of Orgrimmar in Durotar. He is affiliated with the Tinkers' Union. He also gives the only 2 Alliance quests available in Durotar. He is not seen during the events of the Siege of Orgrimmar, but he travels with the Horde to . He is part of the Horde's Garrison in Frostwall as the blueprints vendor.
Rhinag is a jungle troll quest giver located in the building at Rocktusk Farm in Durotar.

Rigglefuzz is a goblin quest giver of the Booty Bay located in a small camp in the Valley of Fangs in the Badlands. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. It seems likely he was killed when Deathwing made the Scar of the Worldbreaker, which blasted clean through Rigglefuzz's camp. This may also explain why Rigglefuzz's former companion Martek the Exiled now seems prone to drinking heavily and harboring a deep hatred toward Deathwing.
Permanently enchant gloves to grant a minor movement bonus while mounted. Enchanting Level Required: 250
Rigger Gizelton is a wandering goblin quest giver located on the road between Kormek's Hut and the Gelkis Village in Desolace. Rigger is part of the Gizelton Caravan.

The Riding Turtle is obtained by finding a rare Saltwater Snapjaw "Loot Card" from the Heroes of Azeroth expansion set of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game from Upper Deck Entertainment. The card has a scratch-off code which is used to obtain the item. Originally, a given code would only give you one turtle on one character on one server, so you wouldn't get it on all your characters (unlike the collector's edition companions). The Saltwater Snapjaw card comes in both loot and ordinary forms; only the loot version has the scratch off code. The card is apparently extremely rare and sells for as much as several hundred dollars on eBay. The initial printing of the card game sold out almos

.]] Riflemen are highly skilled sharpshooters armed with rifles. While dwarves were among the first to invent and use them, many races since took up these weapons.
Riding Crop is a craftable trinket which increases a mount's speed.

The following riding trainers teach the skill necessary to ride specific mounts. Higher level trainers also teach lower level ranks. A riding trainer will mail you a letter once you have gained the level requirements for a new skill.
Ridge Stalker Patriarchs are cheetahs found in the Badlands.
Rift Stalker Gauntlets are the Hunter Tier 5 gloves, part of the Rift Stalker Armor set.
Rift Stalker Leggings are the Hunter Tier 5 legs, part of the Rift Stalker Armor set.
Rift Stalker Hauberk is the Hunter Tier 5 chest, part of the Rift Stalker Armor set.
Rift Stalker Helm is the Hunter Tier 5 head, part of the Rift Stalker Armor set.
Rift Stalker Mantle is the Hunter Tier 5 shoulder, part of the Rift Stalker Armor set.

Rhinoceroses, more commonly known as rhinos, are a type of large, horned beast found in Northrend (primarily the Borean Tundra, Storm Peaks and Sholazar Basin) and on the Dragon Isles (exclusively in the Ohn'ahran Plains). The rhinos of Northrend are covered in shaggy fur, while those of the Dragon Isles are hairless. At some point, Toby "Mother Goose" Ironbolt captured a rhino on the Borean Tundra. The shaggy beast carries an enormous grudge after being bridled by a gnome.
Ribbed Breastplate is a quest reward from Humbert's Sword (quest).
Rhombeard Protector is a Level 55 quality Shield that improves Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.
Ridgeback Bracers are a quest reward from WANTED: Murkdeep! (quest)
The Rifle of the Stoic Guardian drops from Teron Gorefiend in the Black Temple.
Rift Keepers are infinite dragonspawn located in the Black Morass.
__NOTOC__ Rift Lords are infinite dragonspawn located in the Black Morass.
Rig Blueprints is found inside Thermaplugg's Safe in Gnomeregan. You must defeat Mekgineer Thermaplugg to get Thermaplugg's Safe Combination and unlock the safe (located at the back of the room).
Ribbly's Head drops from Ribbly Screwspigot in Blackrock Depths.
Ribsplitter is a zone drop from mobs inside Blackrock Depths.
Ribbly's Cronies are jungle trolls and tauren found in Blackrock Depths. They work for Ribbly Screwspigot.

Director Riddlevox is the director of the Undermine's Tinkers' Union. He was one of Jastor Gallywix's backers in his play for the position of trade prince of the Bilgewater Cartel. Riddlevox asked his underling Sputtervalve to help eliminate the gnome Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle after he was hired by the Venture Company. Though the director himself didn't say anything about it, Sputtervalve suspected that Riddlevox had been instructed by the trade princes in Undermine to get rid of the gnome, as the princes didn't approve of the Venture Company's consorting with Gerenzo. Riddlevox is also known to have ordered a dozen of his favorite "Excelsior-line boots" from Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
Rezznik is a goblin engineer, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena.
Ridgewell's Crate is provided as an objective for Delivery to Ridgewell.
Riders on the Storm is the chapter three (3) of the prologue campaign, Exodus of the Horde, in Warcraft III Demo and the chapter one (1) of the custom campaign of Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne.

is a nickname for any group or party who can "rez" (resurrect). Not having someone in this role can slow down group progress due to dead members having to run to their corpses after they die. Previously, this was a problem with druid healers because they could only resurrect once every 20 minutes, but now that all classes that can heal can resurrect, it is very unlikely that you will ever need to look for a separate rezzer. Primary rezzers: priests, paladins, shamans, and druids. Secondary rezzers: warlocks and engineers.
Ribbon Dance is a buff gained by dancing around the Ribbon Poles.
Rig Hauler AC-9 is a crowd pummeler found in Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra. It was built by the gnomes to move the bombers onto the runway.
Rhie-Ay's Clutching Gauntlets are a world drop from level 75 - 81 Northrend mobs.
The crash-site called Ricket's Folly can be found just to the west of K3 within the Storm Peaks. Its origins are explained in Clean Up. Dim Flathoof wanders the area, seemingly on this quest.
Rift Striders drop from Anomalus in the Nexus on heroic mode.
Riding White Stallions are horses that can be found in many areas of Azeroth.
Rhinolicious Wormsteak is created by Northrend Cooking (25); taught by Recipe: Rhinolicious Wormsteak.
__NOTOC__ Rhino Meat is a drop from rhinos primarily used for cooking but can also be fed to pets.
Rhino Dogs is created with Northrend Cooking (1); taught by cooking trainers.
Ricket is a goblin located at K3 in The Storm Peaks. She later appears in Deepholm, Mount Hyjal, and the Molten Front.
Rigger Sparklight was a goblin in the Strand of the Ancients that provided demolishers for the attacking team.
Rheanna is a human quest giver located at the Blue Sky Logging Grounds in the Grizzly Hills.

Rhukah is (along with Nargut) one of the worg pets of Uda the Beast. During the purge of Dalaran, she stayed with Uda. When Uda was rescued, Rhukah was devouring a Silver Covenant Vanquisher. She accompanied Uda to the Isle of Thunder. She later returned to Dalaran above the Broken Isles.
Rhok'shalla, the Shadow's Bane can be found inside the Tribute Chest after defeating Anub'arak in the 10-man version of Trial of the Grand Crusader.
The Rhaze are a group of arakkoa found at Veil Rhaze in Terokkar Forest. The village was eradicated by the Auchindoun disaster, but Terokk's influence remained in the maligned spirits there.
A debuff caused by the Winter Veil item Red Rider Air Rifle. This debuff occurs randomly and is placed on the user of the item while also stunning the user.
A version of the Riding Training Pamphlet arrives in the mail once a character is high enough level to learn Apprentice rank Riding. The precise text of it depends on the character's race.

Introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm a ride path is a primary means of zone-to-zone travel in the underwater realm of Vashj'ir. They are a transportation link between two fixed geographical points via fixed paths on underwater mounts.
Rhea's Camp is a very small dot of land located in Lethlor Ravine of the Badlands. The only inhabitant is Rhea, a neutral Goblin who is in fact a red dragon in disguise.

__NOTOC__ Rifle Commander Coe is an elite human quest giver found in Stormwind Stockade. Despite his personal desires to have his men blast the rebels in the Stockades to bits he respects Warden Thelwater's command to keep them contained. Having befriended Mortimer Moloch, who happens to be the ruthless rebel leader Randolph Moloch's twin. Coe plans on killing Randolph, so Mortimer can pretend to be Randolph and bring the rebellion to a peaceful end. However, when Mortimer fakes his own death, Coe's figures that he will just take on his brother's name and continue his 'epic schemes' and merely says that they will have to deal with that when the time comes.
__NOTOC__ Rhyanda is a Highborne night elf mage trainer located in Aldrassil in Shadowglen in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Rifle Commander's Eyepatch is a reward from the following quests: *The Gnoll King *Grant Me Revenge
Rhagha is holding the portal leading to Orgrimmar open in the cellar of Tol Barad when the Horde have ownership.
Ricket's Tickers are provided as an objective for Underground Economy.

This quest is part of the Children's Week quests where you escort the orcish orphan Grunth. All of Ridin' the Rocketway, The Fallen Chieftain, and Strong New Allies must be completed to progress to the next pair of quests.
Rhyolith Plateau is the opening to an inactive volcano within the Firelands. This area can be reached after making it through the Ridge of Ancient Flame. Lord Rhyolith is fought here.

The Ridge of Laughing Winds is a ridge located west of the Temple of Five Dawns and south of the Morning Breeze Village on the Wandering Isle. It's here several pandaren scrolls of wisdom hang and were defiled by the hozen.
Rift Elvers are critters found in Abyssal Depths and Shimmering Expanse.

__NOTOC__ Right and Left are Wrathion's bodyguards. They can be found accompanying him in the Tavern in the Mists, at the Veiled Stair, and on the Timeless Isle. They accompanied their master to the trial of Garrosh Hellscream at the Temple of the White Tiger. She can be found with Left, at the Scalecracker Keep during Blacktalon Intel, Obsidian Bulwark, and Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Riddle of Steel is an alternate alchemy transmute. By using three Spirit of Harmony, Living Steel can be created without the daily cooldown incurred by Transmute: Living Steel.
Richard Steven Horvitz is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions. He was the voice of Zim in the tv show, Invader Zim.
Riches of Pandaria is an exploration achievement earned for finding all of the Treasures of Pandaria.

:Rice Pudding is a familiar and comforting dish across a number of cultures, so it's no great surprise to see it in Pandaria as well. Its rich and creamy texture, with slight hints of exotic spices, is just the thing for dessert or even breakfast. :This recipe comes from the Valley of the Four Winds and is a favorite of the pandaren cooking master Sungshin Ironpaw. If you want to be a Master Cook, first you'll need to perfect your Rice Pudding!
__NOTOC__ Rice Flour is a cooking ingredient that can be purchased with Ironpaw Token from Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market. Additionally, A Present for Teacher offers 5 as a reward.

Rhonin's Beard is one of three Alliance battleships used by the Kirin Tor Offensive to lay claim to the Isle of Thunder. Until the Alliance claims Shaol'mara, she is anchored south of Za'Tual in Backbreaker Bay west of The Seabolt and Spellsails, the other two ships.
Riderless Battle Worgs were worgs located in Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar during the Darkspear Rebellion.
__NOTOC__ Rhoho is a centaur located at the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
__NOTOC__ Rhunok's Tormentor is an ice troll located at the Altar of Rhunok in Zul'Drak.
Rhona Irongrin was the daughter of Carrick Irongrin. During the Second War, she died during a Dragonmaw attack on her village in Northeron.

__NOTOC__ Rezlorg is a former student of the and an emissary from the Gorian Empire that has been sent to the Iron Horde at Ironfist Harbor in . Rezlorg's camp, which his host (presumably General Kull'krosh) had prepared for him, is little more than a large fire, several hide mats, and two roughshod huts, much to his dismay. Several Highmaul Emissary Guards oversee the surrounding area, and an inscrutable Iron Horde Liaison can be found near him.
Ricky Bozwallop is a goblin found behind Warspear's Gallywix's Garage on Ashran.
__NOTOC__ Riasa Songbrook is a blood elf located at Deathweb Hollow in Talador.
The Riding Harness is a crafted mount that summons the Dustmane Direwolf.
Ricardo Biriba is a lead animator for cinematics at Blizzard Entertainment.
Richard Green is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Rick Wasserman is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Rhut'van Passage is a road that passes along the Rhut'van Divide from Val'sharah to the Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
Riding Bats are giant bats dead on the ground of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde). They were the mounts of Darkspear Bat Riders.
Rift Stabilization Shard drops from Viz'aduum the Watcher in the Return to Karazhan.
Rhonda Cox is Associate Producer at Blizzard Entertainment on the World of Warcraft Sound Design, Music & Voice Over team. She is referenced by the NPC Rhonda.
Riala the Hearthwatcher is a vrykul innkeeper found at Valdisdall located in Stormheim.
Richard Hatstock is a worgen located at the Threads of Fate in Dalaran.
Rezzle, also known as Captured Wyrmtongue is a wyrmtongue located in Deadwind Pass.

The Riddle of the Mind-Seekers is a puzzle to obtain the Riddler's Mind-Worm mount. The puzzle consists of riddles where you'll have to hunt down pages across Azeroth in a certain order, and the clues to find each page are inspired by World of Warcraft: Chronicle Volume 1. The initial page numbers even spell out the ISBN of the book: 9781616558451. Use this script to track your progress: /run local a={45470,47207,47208,47209,47210,47211,47212,47213}for i,q in ipairs(a)do print(format("Page %s: %s",i, IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(q) and "\124cFF00FF00Done\124r" or "\124cFFFF0000Not Done\124r")) end You have to click the pages in order else you can't see the next one.
Riding Mammoth are mammoths located at the Steam Pools in Feralas. The Resort Staff sees to it, that the animals stay in tip-top shape during their stay.

Riding Wolf can be found at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens and at Gadgetzan in Tanaris. They were also present during the Legion Invasions. They are also seen at the Horde-controlled High Perch in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.

The Riddle of the Lucid Nightmare is a puzzle to obtain the Lucid Nightmare mount. The puzzle consists of riddles where you'll have to hunt inconspicuous notes across Azeroth in a certain order. Use this script to track your progress: /run local N,t,d={"DAL","ULD","AQ","DEEP","GNOME","VAL","MAZE","MOUNT"},{47826,47837,47841,47850,47852,47863,47881,47885} for s,k in pairs(N)do d=C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(t[s]) print(k,"=",d and "\124cFF00FF00" or "\124cFFFF0000NOT","DONE")end
Rezira the Seer is a darkglare located in the Observer's Locus in the Antoran Wastes. Can be reached through the use of the Observer's Locus Resonator.
Riftweaver Daevas is a man'ari eredar that was attacked several times by the champions of various class orders.
Rickety Skeletons are skeletal orcs summoned by Darkmaster Go'vid on the Isle of Shadows in .
Rich Illusion Dust is created by combining 3 Light Illusion Dust.
The Ridgeback Piglet is a possible reward from opening a Growling Sac.

Rid'lah is a Zandalari troll located at Taste of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. He challenges adventurers to test their minds. If they pass the test, they will be rewarded with some Befuddlin' Brew. He was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.
__NOTOC__ Riftblade Kelain is a void elf located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
__NOTOC__ Ridge Prowlers are tigers located in the hills near Fort Wrynn and the in Talador.
Rich Storm Silver Deposits can be found in Kul Tiras. These veins can be mined for Storm Silver Ore.
Rich Platinum Deposits can be found in Kul Tiras. These veins can be mined for Platinum Ore.
Riding Horses are horses located in Tanaris, Dragonblight, and the Arathi Highlands.

The Riding Macaw is a parrot located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Righteous Blade is a Retribution paladin artifact trait. IT is linked to the Blade of Light and Unbreakable Will (artifact trait) traits.

Rickety Ballistae are night elven ballistae located in Val'sharah. They can be found among the ramparts of Black Rook Hold. Made of wood and steel, they are covered in cobwebs and are modeled after a raven.
There are five Rickety Planks throughout the deserts of Vol'dun. Riding each of them is required for Dune Rider.
The Ridge Runner is a hawkstrider that constantly runs in a large circuit around western Vol'dun at very high speeds. It is pursued by Wiley.
The Riddle of Baa'l is a puzzle to obtain Baa'ls Darksign. The puzzle consists of riddles where you'll have to hunt and rub pebbles across Kul Tiras and Zandalar in a certain order.
The Riddle of the Hivemind is a puzzle to obtain The Hivemind (mount).

Rigger Unjaazi is a skeletal troll who walks back and forth between the shore and an underwater alcove between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun, carrying crates from underwater up onto dry land.

Rigger Balajai is a skeletal troll who carries crates between an underwater stash located inbetween the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun and another pile of crates deeper in the sea.

Rhan'ka is the seemingly insane proprietor of the Goldtusk Inn in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun, as well a member of the Goldtusk Gang. Norah calls him "odd", and Rikati describes him as "crazier than a bag of ranishu".

Ridge Lashers are lashers that roam Carapace Ridge in Vol'dun during Charging the Batteries and A Few More Charges. Rolling into them causes the Voracious Ranishu to automatically eat them, granting 3% quest progress.
Rich Honey can be obtained from bee hives in Stormsong Valley.
Rhenik Loyalists are human pirates loyal to Captain Rhenik located in Tiragarde Sound.
Rigging Slicer is sold by: *Headhunter Lani *Spearmon Kol *Arbo
Rich Felslate Deposit can be found throughout the Broken Isles. These veins can be mined for Felslate. They have a chance to spawn Felslate Basilisk.
Ridge Subjugators are sethrak that ride around the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun on the backs of Subjugated Pterrordax.
Ridge Muzzlers are sethrak located on the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun. They are accompanied by Tamed Pterrordax Hatchlings. They are also present during Faction Assaults.
Ridge Beastbreakers are sethrak located on the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun.
Rhett George is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Richard Pepple is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Rich Azerite Deposits were :Azerite nodes found at Nazj'vel in Darkshore. They contained Azerite Crystals.
Rezan the Hunter is a statue located in the Temple of Rezan in Zuldazar.
Rezan the Conqueror is a statue located in the Temple of Rezan in Zuldazar.
Rezan the King is a statue located in the Temple of Rezan in Zuldazar.
Rhan'ka's Escape Plan is sold by Rhan'ka in Vol'dun for . It summons Rhan'ka's Cauldron.
Ridgeplate Pauldrons drops from the Conclave of the Chosen in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Richtofen's Wind Rider is a wyvern located in Thousand Needles. Twilight Skymaster Richtofen rides it but during the battle against the adventurers, it shakes Richtofen off and escapes.
Riding Raptors are raptors located at Shoaljai Tar Pits in Nazmir. Two of them are found, but a third survived Zulajin's ambush and was later used to attack it.
__NOTOC__ Riftweaver Adepts are void elves located in Vol'dun during the Faction Assaults.
Rich Elementium vein requires 500 Mining to mine. These mining nodes can be found in Deepholm, Twilight Highlands, Uldum, Tol Barad Peninsula, and Tol Barad.
Rich Obsidium deposit requires 450 Mining to mine. Found possibly only in Deepholm.
Rich Pyrite deposit requires Mining to mine. Found only in Tol Barad Peninsula, Tol Barad and Twilight Highlands.
Rich Ghost Iron Deposits requires 550 Mining to mine. They are found in nearly all Pandaria zones.
A Rich Trillium Vein requires 600 Mining to mine. It is found in most Pandaria zones.
Rich Osmenite Deposits can be found in Nazjatar. These veins can be mined for Osmenite Ore.
The Riftworld Codex drops from Portal Keeper Hasabel in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Ridge Lashlets are small, untargetable dead spitters found in groups on Carapace Ridge in Vol'dun.
Ridge Crawlers are large beetles mainly located on Carapace Ridge in Vol'dun, but a few are also seen further up the Cracked Coast near the Terrace of the Devoted.
Ridge Skimmers are small beetles located on Carapace Ridge in Vol'dun. Many are seen feasting on dead Cracked Pricklevines or Ridge Lashlets.
Richly Appointed Drape is a quest reward from I Am the Trashmaster.
The Rift Diver is provided as an objective for Most Delicious Clams.

Rich Jelly has a chance to drop from the following mobs in Stormsong Valley: *Gurg the Hivethief *Honey Smasher *Honeyback Usurper *Old Nasha *The Hivekiller *Trapdoor Bee Hunter *Yorag the Jelly Feaster It can be looted from Jelly Deposits or is sold by the Honeyback Hivemother for 4x Thin Jelly.

The Rib-Bone Choker of Dominance can be purchased for 1,000 Honor from in Boralus or in Zuldazar after having a PvP rating of at least 1,400 in the previous week. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 3 of the Conflict and Strife Essence and leave behind Scattered Bones.
Rift Wyrms are mana wyrms located at the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar in Azsuna.
Ri'lij the Dreamer is a n'raqi located in the Morrowchamber in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Rheus is a kyrian located at the Aspirant's Rest in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Rich Grazer Milk is sold by trade goods vendors in the Shadowlands.
Rich Empyrium Deposits are mining ores which can be found and mined on Krokuun, Antoran Wastes, and Eredath.
Rich Sinvyr Deposits can be found in Revendreth. These veins can be mined for Sinvyr Ore.
Riding Stag is a runestag located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
The Riding Hook is provided as an objective for Aerial Advantage.
Rezani Handlers are Zandalari trolls located in Zuldazar. They notably handle devilsaur training at the Warbeast Kraal. They are present in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.
Rich Elethium Deposits can be found in the Shadowlands. These veins can be mined for Elethium Ore.

Riftblades are void elves seen wearing plate armor and either a two-handed sword or a sword and shield. These blades are often enchanted with Void energies, likely inspiring their name. They could potentially be a supplement for the void elves' warrior role.
Ridge Condors are condors located in Frostwall and in the Bones of Agurak and Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Rich Phaedrum Deposits can be found in Ardenweald. These veins can be mined for Phaedrum Ore.
Rich Solenium Deposits can be found in Bastion. These veins can be mined for Solenium Ore.

Ricocheting Inflatable Pyrosaw is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on engineering-crafted Azerite Armor goggles, which require Kul Tiran or Zandalari Engineering to equip. The lowest item level goggles require a skill level of 115, while the highest require 175.
Rich Laestrite Deposits can be found in the Shadowlands. These veins can be mined for Laestrite Ore.
Righteous Bastion is an Azerite trait for Protection paladins. It doesn't appear to be available.
Ric Catstalker is a tauren located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. He laughs as Max and Luke are running in front of him.
Riding with my Slimes is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses while affected by Plaguefallen within a single visit in Plaguefall on Mythic difficulty.
__NOTOC__ Rigged Plagueborers are bloodlice located in Plaguefall.

Rift Portals are located at a few locations in Korthia, granting access to The Rift. They require a Repaired Riftkey to be successfully interacted with. Purchase riftkeys at (honored) with the Archivists' Codex faction from Archivist Roh-Suir for 100 Cataloged Research each. Players need to be in the Rift to interact with: *Reliquary Restoration relics **Book of Binding: The Tormented Sorcerer (item), Scholar's Den **Cipher of Understanding (item), Windswept Aerie **Enigmatic Decrypting Device (item), Seeker's Quorum **Unstable Explosive Orb (item), Sanctuary of Guidance *Conquering Korthia rares **Deadsoul Hatcher, Path of Understanding **Silent Soulstalker, Vault of Secrets **Screaming Sha

Rift Hidden Caches are lootable once-daily chests found in The Rift of the Maw while the Night Fae Assault is active. Find ten to earn the achievement Jailer's Personal Stash. See the Rift article for information on how to access the Rift. Caches contain ~35 Stygia.

Four Riftbound Caches are found in The Rift of Korthia each day. Access the Rift by using a Repaired Riftkey at any Korthian Rift Portal, purchased at (honored) with the Archivists' Codex from Archivist Roh-Suir for 100x Cataloged Research. Caches contain 9-15x Relic Fragment and 10-12 uncommon-quality anima items (50-60 anima). They also contain the Stolen Korthian Supplies (item) once a week. They may also contain 1-3x Ashen Liniment, Korthian Armaments, Shaded Skull Shoulderguards, and Shadehunter's Crescent. Night Fae Covenant players may find the Spider Soul inside.
Riftbound Vorkai are vorkai trapped in the Rift. Margrave Sin'dane tasks players to save them in A Shady Place during the Night Fae Assault on the Crucible of the Damned.
Richly Calligraphed Invitations drop from stone fiends in Revendreth.
The Rift-Bound Shadow Piercer drops from the Blinding Shadow in The Rift in the Maw.
